verdict: Re-marked 2026-09-29: Ascended Heroes has edged back ahead, AH26 88.45 vs DR25 87.68 on the Sep 28 mark (since the Aug 24 launch at 100.00: −11.55% vs −12.32%); the lead has changed hands twice in six marks (AH ahead Aug 31, Sep 7, Sep 28; DR ahead Sep 14, Sep 21). Latest week −5.8% (AH, fourth straight fall) vs −8.4% (DR, its biggest weekly fall). AH top three sold-comp medians sum $2,202.98 vs $755.40. Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex SIR: DR #231 $420.50 (30 sales, Sep 17–28) vs AH #281 $250.00 (30 sales, Sep 15–29). Destined Rivals is the cheaper sealed entry: ETB lowest ask $115.00 (23 live) vs $158.99 (14 live), booster bundle $50.00 vs $72.15 (Sep 29); DR factory booster box lowest ask $429.99 (4 live), no AH factory box listing.
